summary: Implemented TimeElapsedColumn feature in the rich repository, uncommitted and untested. Tests were not run per instructions, so the regenerated test_columns expected string is unverified; bar glyph counts were checked with grep. Next step: run pytest on tests/test_progress.py and tests/test_palette.py.
